test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward scores and gradients
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion by composing emissions, transitions, and FAL graphs to compute loss and gradients
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path by composing emissions and transitions graphs and extracting the best path labels
create_emissions_graph: create an emissions graph from a flat vector of probabilities or log-probabilities with given time steps and classes
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC graph from a target label sequence and a blank token index for alignment
